_doc: Verdicts for the 150 claims of sample-G.claims.json (seed 20261025, drawn from the DATA build after the sample F fixes (tmp/data-audit/data-R1c). v: C correct (for an estimate: inside the range the sources allow), I incorrect or unsupported, L labelled (a Contested or modelled note is on the claim), U cannot be checked against the sources read (excluded). Evidence for a claim judged C without its own line is the source class named for its category; the evidence of every error, label and unverifiable claim is given. The errors were corrected after the draw (83rd Pennsylvania place in the line, the 26th North Carolina day-1 note); a sweep of each class followed (AUDIT.md section 4).
